value: cluster-robust sandwich over Mate Networks of the stacked two-step estimating equations (thresholds, stratum means and variances, then rho), G/(G-1) small-sample factor
Fisher z for correlations, log for the odds ratio
Mate Networks are independent. Dependence from remating is kept; dependence between networks through ancestry or siblings is not modelled.

one_step: each draw refits the first step (thresholds, stratum moments) and every closed-form estimator exactly on the resampled Mate Networks, and takes one Newton step for rho from the observed estimate with the draw-weighted score and the full-sample Hessian
father trait vectors exchangeable within blocks

score_at_zero: the score of the latent-correlation log-likelihood at rho = 0 with every margin refit on the permuted pairs (polychoric, tetrachoric, polyserial, biserial); pearson: Pearson r (continuous x continuous)
